scope: Exploratory historical follow-up after observing the low-family extrapolation failure. Not an independently validated amendment of the frozen campaign.
baseline_definition: Saved positive linear held-out predictions, projected onto [0,1]; no refit or new tuning.
ablation_definition: Remove raw_B9 or real_B9 only, refit all remaining coefficients and tune within the original inner folds.
linear_training: Same nonnegative squared-error ridge fit and unbounded inner MSE selection as the original full model. Project only the delivered predictions onto [0,1].
bounded_training: Fractional Bernoulli cross entropy with sigmoid link, nonnegative slopes, free intercept, ridge on standardized slopes. Ridge selected by bounded inner MSE.
preprocessing: Mean and population standard deviation learned in each training fold. Training-constant coordinates receive zero coefficients even if they change at test time.
contrasts: Each of the 3 new arms versus current_clip, plus fractional_logit_no_b9 versus fractional_logit. 40 simultaneous contrasts per validation scheme (2 representations x 5 targets x 4 comparisons). Scenario-level paired bootstrap averages the five deadlines first. Conditional on fitted predictions; does not cover post-hoc model-design selection or retraining uncertainty.
